My dear [Miss Medhurst](../persons.html#988)
Thanks for your verses which no doubt will please many, though I have never set foot in Brighton and so have no knowledge of the place.[^1] I never thanked you for the good news of [Mrs Mercier](../persons.html#990) who I hope is quite well again

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: These verses do not seem to have been published in MP.
